title: Delivery queue depth
sqlTemplate: select max(queues_rum_queuedepth) as rum_queue_depth, max(queues_logs_queuedepth) as log_queue_depth, max(queues_rum_deadletterdepth) as rum_dlq_depth, max(queues_logs_deadletterdepth) as log_dlq_depth from _chicek_delivery_ops where service = 'telemetry-delivery-worker'
emptyDataSemantics: No telemetry-delivery-worker aggregate events in range renders NO_DATA; this is an operational visibility gap, not zero queue depth.
